items.title: Russia's digital ruble accounts top 220K in first month, nearly 4X central bank forecast
items.summary: The digital ruble's early uptake comes as BRICS nations explore linking their digital currencies for cross-border trade and payments.

items.title: Bill aims at stopping US lawmaker bets on their own elections ahead of midterms
items.summary: The No Betting on Your Own Race Act will not be addressed before the 2026 US midterms as Congress is on recess until after the election.

items.title: Affluent investors seen boosting crypto exposure: Survey
items.summary: Most affluent investors across seven countries own and are increasing their crypto holdings despite financial advisers who remain overly cautious about digital assets.

items.title: Bitcoin grinds toward $87K as US equities hit new record highs
items.summary: Headline tape only, not a desk price. Bitcoin price action was kept in check by overhead ask liquidity while US stocks broke out to new all-time highs.

items.title: Securitize stock jumps 8% amid South Korea tokenization push
items.summary: The LG CNS partnership gives Securitize a foothold as Seoul prepares new rules for tokenized stocks, bonds and funds beginning in February 2027.

items.title: ECB policymaker warns of fragmentation without digital euro
items.summary: An ECB executive board member said a digital euro would not take over the role of banks, but ensure they have a role in the EU monetary system.

items.title: Another Zcash ETF Is Coming: Winklevoss Twins File for 'WINK'
items.summary: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, trade on Nasdaq under WINK with Gemini as custodian.

items.title: Mistral AI Drops 'Le Chonk': A Massive AI Model Named After a Cat Meme
items.summary: Paris-based Mistral launched Large 4, a model nicknamed after a June internet joke.

items.title: Bitcoin Falls Asleep, But Privacy Coins Zcash and Monero Are Waking Up
items.summary: Headline tape only, not a desk price. Bitcoin and Ethereum barely moved today, but Zcash and Monero are leading the largest coins over the last 24 hours.

items.title: Flash Loan Attacks Drained $1.2B From DeFi Between 2020 and 2024: Study
items.summary: Attacks grew more sophisticated and less predictable over the period, according to researchers who scanned more than 20 billion transactions.

items.title: Circle, Ripple and Standard Chartered Back OKX at Flat $25B Valuation

items.title: Conduit sues Tether over $2.76 million freeze, says it has 'no legal entitlement' to funds
items.summary: Conduit is suing Tether in NY federal court, alleging the USDT issuer froze $2.76 million of its funds for over a year without explanation.

items.title: Winklevoss group seeks to launch Zcash ETF with 0.25% fee, proposed WINK ticker
items.summary: Winklevoss Asset Services filed for a spot Zcash ETF under ticker WINK, with Gemini as custodian and a 0.25% fee, rivaling Grayscale ZCSH.

items.title: Solana treasury DeFi Development authorizes CHAD preferred stock buyback program
items.summary: Solana treasury firm DeFi Development approved an open-ended program to repurchase CHAD preferred stock if it trades below its $10 par value.

items.title: Brevan Howard to use Ripple Prime for multi-asset brokerage, clearing and financing
items.summary: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing to Brevan Howard, deepening a tie that began with its Ripple investment.

items.title: Polymarket rolls out V2 upgrade with single ERC-1155 positions contract, pUSD collateral
items.summary: Polymarket rolls out Protocol V2, replacing its legacy Gnosis-based setup with a single ERC-1155 positions contract and pUSD collateral.

items.title: Fortitude expands Zcash mining push with up to $100 million equipment commitment
items.summary: Fortitude secured priority access to BITMAIN next-generation Zcash miners as it expands capacity and increases financing from DCG.

items.title: FinCEN drops crypto mixing proposal as backlash kills rule

items.title: Ripple and Circle backs OKX as it targets the next wave of stablecoin users
